findings.issue: בְּעַרְבֹת is a common noun, feminine plural construct; arabot leaves that lemma untranslated and does not express the plural in Spanish.

notes: Y acamparon, sobre, el Yarden, desde Bet Hayeshimot, hasta Avel Hashitim, en, and de Moab match the conjunction, verb, prepositions, article, proper names, and construct.
